_note: Internal development only. MonkeyHub is the sole production launcher (OPEN_MONKEYHUB.cmd, the desktop package). These profiles start services on an explicit project for smoke runs and UI work; the project comes from ARCHFLOW_STUDIO_PROJECT_DIR, else from the Hub's own application settings.

configurations.name: studio-api-dev
runtimeArgs: import os, sys; from pathlib import Path; sys.path.insert(0, 'apps/archflow-studio/api'); from archflow_studio_api.main import main; from archflow_studio_api.settings import read_application_settings; project = os.environ.get('ARCHFLOW_STUDIO_PROJECT_DIR') or read_application_settings(Path(os.environ['LOCALAPPDATA']) / 'MonkeyHub').project_dir or sys.exit('Set ARCHFLOW_STUDIO_PROJECT_DIR, or choose a project in MonkeyHub once (LOCALAPPDATA/MonkeyHub/config/applications.json).'); main(['--project-dir', str(project), '--port', '8000'])

configurations.name: studio-api-smoke
runtimeArgs: import os, sys; from pathlib import Path; sys.path.insert(0, 'apps/archflow-studio/api'); from archflow_studio_api.main import main; from archflow_studio_api.settings import read_application_settings; project = os.environ.get('ARCHFLOW_STUDIO_PROJECT_DIR') or read_application_settings(Path(os.environ['LOCALAPPDATA']) / 'MonkeyHub').project_dir or sys.exit('Set ARCHFLOW_STUDIO_PROJECT_DIR, or choose a project in MonkeyHub once (LOCALAPPDATA/MonkeyHub/config/applications.json).'); main(['--project-dir', str(project), '--port', '8001'])

configurations.name: monkeyhub-dev
runtimeArgs: import os, runpy, sys; sys.argv = ['apps/monkeyhub/run.py', '--runtime-root', os.path.join(os.environ['LOCALAPPDATA'], 'MonkeyHub-dev'), '--port', '8790', '--hub-web-dir', 'apps/monkeyhub/web/dist', '--no-browser']; runpy.run_path(sys.argv[0], run_name='__main__')
